What's new in 1.4.0

New template: Breakdown
- Dedicated to Vijay Pratap Pandey, VFX compositor (vijayvisuals.github.io).
- Your year as a visual-effects shot breakdown, made for CG artists: a city with one tower for every day, laid out like your contribution calendar and receding week by week toward a setting sun.
- The city extrudes in date order while the timeline plays frames 1001 to 1365, then the frame wipes through the render passes (wireframe, clay, normals, depth) to a dusk beauty pass with lit windows, street lamps and an anamorphic flare. Your name is lettering in the scene, so every pass renders it.
- Comp script: your repos as a node graph, each with a material-preview thumbnail in its language colour, plus a render log of your year and your languages as a colour chart.
- End card: the on-set reference kit (grey ball, chrome ball, colour chart) and a sign-off: "Thanks for watching."
- Options: your discipline, a showreel link, your toolkit and the closing line.
- Animated, with dark (dusk) and light (hazy morning) versions, and it respects reduced motion.
